style.styleTitle: Lumineo Pre Lit LED Hanging Star Christmas Bauble
style.toneOfVoice: <p>These beautiful Lumineo LED glass ornaments are perfect for adding a touch of elegance to your indoor Christmas decor. Shaped like a dazzling star, they feature a warm white micro LED light and a mesmerising sparkle effect that will surely catch everyone's eye. With dimensions of 20 cm in both width and height, this ornament is an ideal centrepiece or a charming addition to your festive displays.</p><ul><li>Made from sleek grey glass with a silver colour cable<br></li><li>Contains 20 micro LED bulbs with a cosy warm white glow<br></li><li>Designed for indoor use only<br></li><li>Includes a 100 cm lead cable for easy setup<br></li><li>Operates on 2 AAA batteries (not included) with a 48-hour working time</li></ul><p>Thanks to its battery operation, you can place this star-shaped ornament anywhere you like without worrying about power outlets. A practical 6-hour timer ensures the lights turn on and off automatically, making your festive preparations a breeze.</p>
